newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala 9-mth net up 32 pct 4.95 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Ayala 9-mth net up 32 pct 4.95 bln pesos.

text.p: Ayala Corp said on Wednesday its net income jumped by 32 percent to 4.95 billion pesos in the first nine months of the year.

"The growth was driven by sustained income performance of Ayala companies in the real estate, banking, insurance and electronics industries," Ayala senior managing director Mercedita Nolledo said in a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange.

The strong profit performances of units Ayala Land Inc, Bank of the Philippine Islands, Ayala Life Insurance Inc, and Integrated Microelectronics Inc, more than offset the weak returns from Globe Telecom and Purefoods Corp.
Ayala said Globe recorded a loss of 530 million pesos .

"Purefoods continue to enjoy leadership position in meats and flour milling but its financial performance for the first nine months were offset by the pressures created by the industry-wide supply glut problem in the poultry," said Nolledo.
Nolledo said her company looks forward to another banner year in 1996 with net income higher than last year's 5.48 billion pesos.
